De la démonomanie des sorciers — Jean Bodin (1593)
==================================================
Jean Bodin's De la démonomanie des sorciers (Of the Demon-Mania of the Witches), 1593 French edition — the most influential demonological treatise of the French witch-hunt era, in four books, public domain. Bodin's legal-theological case for witch prosecution shaped two generations of trials. Scan via Internet Archive.
